values.note: 30-amp site $40 a night, 50-amp $45 (ResNexus, Tue 2027-05-11, 2 adults: back-in sites at $40 and $45). Monthly $550 (30 A) / $650 (50 A) for an RV on site at least 24 continuous days. Boats left in the water $10 a night; no launch fee for RV guests.

fees.source: https://reserve2.resnexus.com/resnexus/reservations/lodging/F620D557-1D4A-4966-A671-AFB1C0805718?StartDate=5/11/2027&EndDate=5/12/2027&roomclass=3 ('Standard Rate $40.00 / night', '$45.00 / night' on the RV Site back-ins) + https://www.almondboatpark.com/rv-park.html ('30 AMP service: $40.00 per night $550 per month 50 AMP service: $45.00 per night $650 per month'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.almondboatpark.com/rv-park.html ('We have full hookups (water, electric, sewer)', '30 AMP service', '50 AMP service'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Gravel-and-grass pads, every one a back-in. The operator publishes no site count (its site plan is 'NOT used as size references'); ResNexus showed 12 RV sites open on a May 2027 Tuesday, plus a long-term site class.

sites.source: https://www.almondboatpark.com/rv-park.html ('All of our sites are back in sites', 'pads are gravel with grass') + ResNexus search (14 results, 'RV Site [long-term]' class), read 2026-10-22. The stored count of 52 rested only on the note prose (directory-derived) and is cleared.

values.note: No bathhouse or public laundry, so no tents: self-contained rigs. Firewood and 20-lb propane cylinders sold; marina with pontoon/deck-boat rentals, boat docks and storage, bait and licences.

facilities.source: https://www.almondboatpark.com/rv-park.html ('We do not have a bathhouse or a public laundry, and therefore do not allow tent camping', 'firewood and 20 pound propane cylinders available for purchase'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.almondboatpark.com/rv-park.html ('We are open from April through October', 'Open April through October'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online through ResNexus ('Check Availability') or 828-488-6423; online bookings still check in at the office.

booking.source: https://www.almondboatpark.com/rv-park.html ('Check Availability' -> ResNexus; 'If you book online you still need to check in at the office'; 'Please call 828-488-6423'), read 2026-10-22

note: RV park and marina on Fontana Lake, about 10 mi from Bryson City; wooded sites. Boat rentals, scenic cruises and cabins on site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40 (30 A) - $45 (50 A) on ResNexus for May 2027, full hookups with 50-amp, April-October season; added all back-in sites, no bathhouse/laundry, ResNexus booking; cleared the directory-derived 52-site count. Note cleaned of hookup/site/season text and of 'hikers shuttle' (not on the operator's pages). Hurricane Helene: open and booking for 2027.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator says 'It is not water front but very close to the lake'; the entry says 'lakefront'.

Ownership: the footer carries 'U.S.F.S.S.U.P. #5475' with the USDA Forest Service nondiscrimination statement - the park operates under a Forest Service special-use permit, i.e. a private concession on National Forest land; the entry says private.

Long-stay: nightly rates posted and booked online (passes test 2); monthly rates for 24+ continuous days and a 'RV Site [long-term]' class exist, share not stated. Under the gate ($40) and within 28 km of Great Smoky Mountains NP anyway.
